title: University of Twente Scholarship (UTS)
about: The University of Twente Scholarship is for excellent non-EU/EER students admitted to a qualifying UT master's programme starting September 2027. The form opened 15 October 2026 and closes 1 April 2027 at 16:00 CET; results are expected in early May 2027.
requirements: (Provisionally) admitted to a qualifying UT master's programme starting in 2027/2028
Scholarship application is separate from the programme application
card_alt: EduCut Connect card for the University of Twente Scholarship (UTS) at the University of Twente, Enschede, Netherlands, deadline 1 Apr 2027. The photo shows gabled canal houses and houseboats in Amsterdam, not Enschede.
